name: Character bounce
what: A simple round character squashes, stretches and hops, to show a character-led style.

name: Paper cut-out
what: Flat paper shapes slide and fold over each other with a soft shadow.

name: 3D card tilt
what: A flat card tilts in depth and settles, to show panels with perspective.

name: Hand-drawn line
what: A line draws itself across the frame as if by a pen, with a slight wobble.

name: Liquid morph
what: One shape flows into another with smooth, rounded in-betweens.

name: Stop motion
what: Objects jump between poses at a low frame rate, like handmade animation.

name: Clay squash
what: A soft block is pressed, squashed and springs back, to show a tactile feel.

name: Collage layers
what: Cut-out pieces stack in layers and drift at different speeds.
